description: Create or update up to 500 contacts per call, matched by phone_number. Attributes go in fields (up to 20 strings, e.g. plan) for segments and {{field:name}} merge tags; tags group contacts. opt_in carries consent evidence (status: false records an opt-out). import_id from the first response groups several calls; dry_run: true returns what would change and writes nothing.

campaign_id.description: Applies to every opt_in row that does not name its own campaign_id

check_line_types.description: dry_run only. Looks up line types to count landlines; live lookups are paid, so only the first 500 numbers are checked.

contacts.description: Contacts to create or update, up to 500 per call

fields.description: Up to 20 string values (account id, plan, location...), usable in segments and as {{field:key}} merge fields

name.description: Display name. Defaults to first + last name.

opt_in.description: Import only (POST /v1/contacts/import). Stored as consent evidence; never lifts an opt-out.

at.description: When they opted in: ISO timestamp, date, or epoch ms

campaign_id.description: The registration the opt-in is for. A marketing or mixed registration needs at, a recognised source, and page_url for a web form, or the row is skipped

page_url.description: The page a web-form opt-in was collected on

source.description: web_form, keyword, paper, checkout or verbal are stored as proof; anything else is kept as a note

status.description: true = opted in; false = unsubscribed (recorded as an opt-out)

source.description: Where the contact came from. Defaults to "api".

state.description: US state or Canadian province, usually a 2-letter code

dry_run.description: true returns what would change and writes nothing

import_id.description: From a previous response, to group several requests as one import.

name.description: A label for the import (first request only).

name: import_contacts
title: Import contacts
